svg.title: LaunchPad run plan
svg.desc: A scanned cube sheet with OCR boxes around each store's cube, where two values are flagged: one misread far above its typical range, one zero that suggests a forgotten store. The corrected numbers are packed into three trailers by first-fit decreasing, and the second run is sequenced on a map from the distribution center, largest cube first. Footer: typed, pasted, CSV, or scanned intake; 197 backend tests.
